purpose: Finite internal-agent validation of the new preprint roadmap and current-status documents; not scientific qualification or a declaration of a complete paper.

peer_review.kind: internal agent peer review, not external expert input
peer_review.disposition: No factual or method-blocking errors; final P02 baseline-ceiling priority incorporated before P03.
peer_review.positioning_scope: Focused seed-based primary-source positioning, not exhaustive novelty or independent biomedical truth.

checks.observation: The current controlled source-reporting paper and narrower technical/feasibility fallback are distinct; manuscript and benchmark-performance completion are not asserted.
P02 source-to-fact feasibility includes a cheap deterministic baseline-ceiling check before P03 evaluator coding; P04 is a bounded actual pilot.
The categorical ten-item adapter and exposed R07 pair audit are optional supplementary work; source/provenance/isolation protections are reused where applicable.
No human response, recruitment, panel, GE confirmation or external expert approval gates current paper completion.

Bespoke human returns and response-aware descendants are archive-only and excluded from new references, generation, evaluation, tuning and selection; source builders get fresh no-fork allowlisted contexts.

Typed facts, quotation mechanics, semantic support and biological truth are separated; AI judgments remain secondary model-conditioned measurements, and zero-slot cases do not pass undefined coverage.
Common denominators and faithful arm adapters are required; adapters cannot add facts or repair outputs. The primary comparable contrast is frozen before generation.

The retained 60-cell/114-call selection study and 32-result/48-call top-one study are actual selection studies. Six R07 HTTP responses/zero contracts, recorded mechanics and preparation-only artifacts remain separate.

31,554 observations across overlapping case worlds, 20 original audited rows, eight tasks across five exposed cases, and zero qualified fresh cases are qualified without independent-sample or truth claims.
Typed-fact coverage, critical-distortion scoring and the 80% H5-A rule remain unimplemented; existing Q1/selection/copy mechanics or categorical schemas do not supply them.

Original H5 remains untested; unsupported clinical predictions stay withheld. The failed 28-cell/58-call attempt, R07 negative result, FAILED/INCOMPLETE_TIMEOUT and no-retry boundaries remain preserved.
Reproducible analyses, manuscript/PDF, bibliography, figures/tables, supplements and disclosures remain pending. Artifact-absence claims are repository-scoped.
A public asset allowlist and per-asset redistribution decisions are required. Response histories/derivatives, credentials and private paths stay outside the public scientific package.
Apache-2.0 code licensing does not license third-party source text/data. Unknown source rights require withholding source bytes and supplying lawful identifiers/locators/instructions.

The release needs installed study/baseline/comparison smoke and lawful fixture replay beyond demo/verify, fresh-root portability, a correctly rejected invalid control and honest old-format matching-version limits.
Exact-release-SHA validation/hosted evidence remains pending. The 20-minute workflow budget versus about 42.4-minute retained local full run is a risk to measure, not evidence that hosted jobs fail.
AI-use/availability/contribution/funding/conflict disclosures and unknown or unmetered platform cost/usage are required. Zero provider spend does not establish total-cost or human-time superiority.
The primary-source URLs are focused seed-based related-work positioning, not an exhaustive gap survey, independent AsOf truth validation or established novelty.
Clinical prediction/scorer/MR, T2-T5, H6, full original Virtual Biotech reproduction, new models, deployment and optional native expansion remain separate conditional work rather than paper gates.
P01 alone is checked; P02-P10 remain pending.

All 25 added/current local Markdown targets and five added/current wikilinks resolve; ten external positioning URLs are inventoried, not fetched/access-qualified. Historical unrelated wikilinks are outside scope.
The 4,877-byte prior TODO is exactly preserved from the reviewed checkpoint.
Eight named metadata files exist and match empirical-peer digests; only byte hashing occurred here, with no candidate/human/protected-outcome payload inspection.
All 327 accepted application/test/tool/resource pins match, totaling 3,825,227 bytes. The 1,774-test pass is retained, not freshly executed.
No runtime, tests, tools, package/lock, catalog, workflow or license change since the reviewed baseline. Documentation-only scope does not require a new full application suite.
All thirteen final reviewed document identities remained stable during validation, including through the root documentation commit.
